1.why: The interface uses a clean, highly legible sans-serif font with generous line and letter spacing.

2.why: All text avoids italics, all-caps sentences, and dense blocks of copy.

3.why: The content is structured neatly and remains well laid out for a mobile display size.

4.why: The instructions are short, direct, and written using plain language.

5.why: Clear example inputs are provided directly inside the form fields.

6.why: The interface only contains short headings and single-sentence prompts rather than long reading blocks.

7.why: No long codes, secrets, or copy functionality are present in any of the application screens.

8.why: No QR code or alternative entry mechanism is displayed in the application.

9.why: There is no visible standard autofill attribute support or password manager integration demonstrated.

10.why: The top step indicator and the bright blue 'Continue securely' button stand out prominently.

11.why: Each screen asks the user to take only one main action at a time.

12.why: The system displays a generic error message after submission without explaining what to do next.

13.why: Users can retry submitting details, but no controls exist to reveal, hide, or re-request verification codes.

14.why: The error message 'Unable to sign in with those details' avoids user blame but fails to state how to fix the issue.

15.why: There are no visible timers or strict time limits imposed on any of the screens shown.
